selection.selectionRule: Twelve diverse W14-passed customer-route cases: one per Life Palace branch, balanced 6 zh-Hans/6 en and 6 MALE/6 FEMALE.

reviewCriteria: Professional reading hierarchy is immediately clear
4x4 twelve-palace chart remains readable without one-character vertical collapse
Palace inspector clearly follows the selected palace and does not duplicate a second essay
Eight topic tabs are discoverable and topic-to-palace navigation is understandable
Natal → Da Xian → Liu Nian timing lane remains distinct and readable
COUNTERBALANCED is expressed as customer language rather than an internal code
Open meaning boundaries are visible without dominating the reading
No WATER_2 / ZI / XU / HAI / SHEN / 结构项 / internal resolution codes appear in default customer UI
No legacy generic ZWR / SMR renderer is visibly mixed with the specialist surface
interactionTasks: Switch at least two topic tabs
Open a topic-linked palace and confirm the same palace inspector becomes active
Select a second palace directly from the 4x4 chart
Inspect timing lane and cross-layer explanation
Open Technical Details only to confirm raw lineage is confined there
